answer: A new identity starts at a dune's foot, on a graduated curve, earning 10% of the full reward. Each honest epoch's pulse lifts the rate 10 points; ten clean epochs cross the canyon to full rate. One fake costs 20 credits; 1,000 fakes cost 20,000, and lifting all 1,000 there takes 250,000 credits of work. Renting an aged identity fails: transfer resets it to 10%. An honest agent pays 20 once, keeps the full reward, and the rate is public on-chain.
